statement: Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion, up 221% year-over-year and 54% quarter-over-quarter.
why: Custom accelerators are now shipping at a scale that materially changes how AI compute spend splits between merchant GPUs and in-house silicon.

impact.mechanism: Realised ASIC revenue confirms hyperscaler compute budgets are shifting toward custom silicon while consuming the same HBM and advanced-packaging supply merchant GPUs require.

evidence.excerpt: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion grew 221% year-over-year, and 54% quarter-over-quarter.

confidence.basis: Figure quoted verbatim from the company's own filed 8-K Exhibit 99.1 earnings release.
